chapter: Reel 2: Los Angeles musicians, the Apex and Cotton Club
title: Where the four bands played; Alton Redd in the drum chairs
summary: Howard cannot say where the other bands played, only that Alton Redd drummed in most; his own band's date relative to the Momart is debated.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel

blocks.x: Buddy, open that door, (inaudible) he's wiping and
going on here --
Well, that's all right. It's summer. -slimming-
It's hot.
Where did the four bands work? I mean, what four places could have bands at the same time?

MR. HOWARD: Now, let me see if we can find that. I doubt whether we can find that, because I don't know it, and I played around with them all, and I don't really know where they played. But I can tell you where Alton played.
Alton?
Yeah. Alton.
Where did he play?
MR. HOWARD: He played in most all of the bands that had drums. I don't know where he was playing at when he quit
playing.
Do you remember where your band was playing at that period?
At that period? Yeah, sure. It was playing at the --
That wasn't the Momart, was it? That you mentioned before?
No. It wasn't the Momart.
That was after the Momart days.
That was after the Momart days, wasn't it?
Yeah.
The Alabam wasn't open then, was it?
I don't know. Might have been.
I don't think so.
I don't know.
